title: EvidenceStore
description: PROPOSAL, not yet implemented. A cross-run, durable index of every EvidenceRecord ever produced, keyed by evidence_id. Additive persistence layer on top of research_evidence.schema.json -- a run's output must remain valid without this store existing. See evidence_store.md for the design rationale, merge algorithm, and the evidence_id-is-not-a-source-key caveat.

record.description: Exactly one EvidenceRecord, unchanged from research_evidence.schema.json. Kept as a nested object (not flattened) so this store never has to fight that schema's additionalProperties: false.

first_seen_run_id.description: run_id (UTC ISO 8601 timestamp of pipeline start) of the run that first produced this evidence_id.

last_seen_run_id.description: run_id of the most recent run that re-derived this same evidence_id.

seen_count.description: Number of runs that have independently produced this exact evidence_id.
